title: Copilot path-specific instructions frontmatter (*.instructions.md)
description: The keys the two sources document, and nothing else: applyTo and excludeAgent (GitHub.com: Copilot cloud agent and code review) and name and description (VS Code). Neither source says what happens to an unknown key or a malformed one, so nothing reports it; this profile does. Project policy on top of the vendor rules: applyTo is required. GitHub.com selects path-specific files by applyTo and has no manual or description-based activation, and VS Code applies a file without applyTo only by task relevance or when attached by hand.

applyTo.description: Glob(s), comma-separated for several (GitHub.com); relative to the workspace root (VS Code).

excludeAgent.description: GitHub.com only. The coding agent was renamed the cloud agent (github/docs, 2026-04-07); 'coding-agent' is not a documented value.

name.description: VS Code only: display name; defaults to the file name.

description.description: VS Code only: the tasks the file is relevant for.
